However, nutrient needs are different for different individuals. For that reason, adequacy of food intake, in terms of energy
(kcal), dietary diversity, and if possible also speciﬁc nutrients (such as micronutrients, protein, and fat), are best collected at the
individual level and expressed per population group, in order to identify which groups are most at-risk from a nutritional point
of view. However, collecting these data at the individual level is very labor intensive and requires detailed food composition
